svg.title: Interpretability: what the network reads and writes
svg.desc: The residual stream is a running sum written by attention and feed-forward blocks. QK circuits read by scoring token pairs; OV circuits write information. Activation patching copies a clean activation into a corrupted run and measures normalized restoration as causal evidence.

g.text: Interpretability: what the network reads and writes
Residual-stream views explain information flow; activation patching tests causal contribution.
QK reads: which positions to attend to
OV writes: what information is added
